correctness.rationale: Exact group generation from 168 GL_3(F2) collineations and 168 polarity compositions gives 336 automorphisms; subgroup-adjoining closure is exhaustive because every finite subgroup has a generating sequence. 413 subgroups split into 23 classes. Fixed barycentric coordinates are constant on each vertex orbit, giving a PL orbit-face model with all orbit unions independent. The inspected certificate code enumerates 22 nontrivial representatives, tests every elementary collapse at deletion, checks sphere surfaces by edge incidence and connected cycle vertex links/Euler characteristic, checks two spheres meeting in exactly a filled triangle and the extra-edge sphere-circle case. Independently generated all 413 subgroups and classified all 22 representative fixed orbit complexes via exact mod-2 chain ranks, reproducing weighted ranks: 21 H2^2;14 H1+H2;42 H1^2;17 reduced H0;301 zero;17 empty. The independent F2 ranks are corroboration, not an integral homotopy proof; inspected collapses/surface gluing supply integral types.
